text_block_list.text:
The practice was very basic, but you two 
are starting to be on the same wavelength! 
However …

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe a trainer who puts their 
Uma first would stop here. I'll be sure to 
check out your next training …!
